title: Separate Decision per Governance Level
summary: An approval contains one decision for each governance level the object's layers require - semantic, information model, data architecture, technical - never a single combined approval.
body_markdown:
# Separate Decision per Governance Level

## Rule

Required levels are derived from the object's `layer` (`decision-rights.yaml` `layer_levels`). The governance record must hold a positive decision per level, by an approver role of that level (E095, E097).

## Rationale

"What does it mean?", "how is it represented?", "how does it participate in the architecture?" and "how is it technically represented?" are different questions with different deciders ([[Decision Rights Model]]).

## Scope

All approvals.

## Enforcement

Automated: E095, E097. Machine definition: AR-002, AR-004.

## Exceptions

None; small teams may have one person in several roles, but the decisions are still recorded separately.
